headline: Binance Hack Serves as $6 Billion Security Warning for Financial Industry
summary: A major security breach involving Binance highlights the technological and operational risks accompanying the digitization of the global financial system.
why: Cybersecurity incidents in major digital asset platforms underline systemic vulnerabilities and prompt tighter security compliance across financial institutions.
